title: First new spec: reply_draft@1 drafts a reply to a support ticket triage set aside

story.i_want_to: a drafted reply for a ticket triage rejected or escalated
story.so_that: I answer the customer faster without the loop sending anything in my name

rationale: The proof that a new agent is a spec: the smallest custody surface (claims nothing, writes no repository, adds no stage edge) and it reuses triage's candidates and payload. Mark's defaults 2 and 3 in the PRD.

acceptance_criteria.description: reply_draft@1 is a :draft spec: candidates are stories with an intake record carrying a ticket_id whose triage ended reject or escalated and which have no draft; payload :fenced_intake_report; screen :injection_detector_draft.
One new effect writes a reply_drafts row (tenant_id, RLS enabled, story_id, ticket_id, body, inserted_at); nothing in loopctl sends it.
A reply_draft_list MCP tool (and endpoint) reads drafts for a project; its description says drafts are never sent by loopctl and which key it needs.

The runner template reply_draft@1 runs on a detached scratch tree nothing pushes, carries no tool list (the runner's unattended-session posture, Mark 2026-09-16), and returns the draft only through agent_result, read from the fenced block ending its final message.
A draft that fails the injection screen is stored as refused with the screen code, never as a draft.

test_cases.name: drafts a set-aside ticket
steps: a ticket story whose triage was rejected
run the pass with a fake runner returning a draft

test_cases.name: never sends
steps: inspect outbound calls during the pass

test_cases.name: injection screened
steps: return a draft carrying an instruction-shaped payload
expected_results: row refused with the screen code
